truth_claims.note: conf=0.95; Confirmed as volume 15 of the Wild Cards shared-universe series edited by George R.R. Martin (Baen, 1995). It is a mosaic/braided novel with contributions by Stephen Leigh, Victor Milán, John J. Miller, Sage Walker and Martin; Martin is credited as editor and is the metadata author. It is the third book of the "Card Sharks" triad (vols. 13-15, "Book III of a New Cycle"), but the standard catalogued numbering is Wild Cards #15. Note: the 2025 Bantam reprint retitled the book "Showdown"; the canonical/original title for this file is Black Trump.

truth_claims.note: conf=0.96; Filename/metadata identification is correct and now filled in. Black Trump (Bantam, 1995) is Volume 15 of the Wild Cards shared-universe series edited by George R. R. Martin. It is a mosaic novel with stories by Stephen Leigh, George R. R. Martin, Sage Walker, John J. Miller and Victor Milan; Martin is credited as editor, but catalogs and the EPUB metadata list him as author, which I have retained. It forms the third book of the informal "Card Sharks Triad" (#13 Card Sharks, #14 Marked Cards, #15 Black Trump), but that triad is a grouping within the single numbered Wild Cards series rather than a separately published/numbered series, so Wild Cards #15 is given. Note: the 2025 Bantam reprint retitled the book "Showdown" (released 18 March 2025); the canonical/original title of this file is Black Trump. No ISBN in the file; original 1995 mass-market edition.
